result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-structured. The main defect is a promotional badge on the pizza card that reads '-100%', which looks like a data or content error. There are also smaller polish issues: low-contrast secondary text and a time pill that overlaps the image edge.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' shows a '-100%' discount badge. That would mean the item is free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting bug, and it conflicts with the tone of the other promos.
issues.suggestion: Check the discount value coming from the backend. Show the correct percentage, or hide the badge if the value is invalid, and add validation to cap or format discounts.

issues.description: Secondary text is light gray on white or light backgrounds: the delivery fee lines, the search placeholder, and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' metadata. Contrast is low, especially for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The delivery-time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') sit at the bottom-left corner of the card images and touch or overlap the image edge. The pill on the first card looks slightly clipped against the image bounds and is inconsistent with the badges on the large cards, which have more padding.
issues.suggestion: Give the pills consistent inset padding from the image edges, matching the badges on the large cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the dark food images has a low-contrast translucent background, so it is less visible. On the pizza card the dark circle blends into the wood background.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque or lighter background for the favorite button, or add a border or shadow.
